verdict.rationale: Devin's docs explicitly support tagging Devin in a Slack or Teams thread about a bug under discussion, which starts a session directly from that conversation to delegate the bug, feature request or question. The evidence is only brief first-party mentions. Missing for 10: detailed docs on in-thread back-and-forth with Devin (progress updates, follow-up replies in the thread), setup/permissions details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can tag an agent in a chat thread to discuss and delegate a bug or task
